episodes.176418: Rain amounts near an inch and melting snow caused flooding issues in the area including Paradise Creek in Moscow.
episodes.176419: Rain amounts above an inch and melting snow caused flooding issues in the Spokane and|Oakesdale areas.

events.narrative: Snow melt and heavy rain along with failing rubber seal in the area caused localized flooding under the Interstate 90 overpass near Monroe Street. 1.25 inches of rain fell in the area.
Water was over the roadway on SR 271 between MP 7 and 8.

Flooding out of a cross forest road water path about 50 to 60 feet wide about 3 inches deep in the Winchester area. Lewis County Sheriff reports that the road feels as if it is eroding as you are driving through it.
